nodes.description: Public token name string, set in the constructor.
Public token symbol string, set in the constructor.
Token decimals (18), used as exponent when computing totalSupply.
Total token supply, computed from initialSupply * 10**decimals.
Mapping of address to balance; mutated by _transfer and the constructors.
ERC20 constructor: computes totalSupply, mints all tokens to msg.sender, sets name and symbol.
Internal base transfer: validates addresses/balances, checks overflow, updates balances, emits Transfer.
Public transfer wrapper that forwards msg.sender, _to and _value to the internal _transfer.
Derived EROSTOKEN constructor delegating to the parent ERC20 constructor.
Overriding internal _transfer in EROSTOKEN with a weaker overflow guard (>= instead of >).
msg.sender: caller address, receives initial supply and acts as _from in transfer.
Arithmetic: totalSupply = initialSupply * 10 ** uint256(decimals); unchecked multiplication in constructor.
Arithmetic: balanceOf[_from] -= _value in base _transfer.
Arithmetic: balanceOf[_to] += _value in base _transfer.
Arithmetic guard: require(balanceOf[_to] + _value > balanceOf[_to]) in base _transfer.
Arithmetic: balanceOf[_from] -= _value in the overriding EROSTOKEN _transfer.
Arithmetic: balanceOf[_to] += _value in the overriding EROSTOKEN _transfer.
Arithmetic guard: require(balanceOf[_to] + _value >= balanceOf[_to]) in EROSTOKEN _transfer; the >= form is a weaker/incorrect overflow check.
